answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because island only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, echo is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
